record.route: Double series S = sum_k sum_{n>=2} (n!)^{-k} = (e-2) + R, R = sum_{n>=2} 1/(n!(n!-1)). Gives no core narrower than the root: irrationality is not additive, so S irrational iff R+e not rational; clearing layers k<=K with (N!)^K leaves (N!)^(K-k) times the k-th tail, about (N!)^(K-k)/(N+1)^k, unbounded for k<K. The factorial-multiplier skeleton (erdos-68@1) uses one layer and keeps the rest finite.
